queries: SELECT l.id AS id, 'line' AS source, l.customer AS customer, l.entry AS entry, l.date AS date, l.currency AS currency, l.debit AS debit, CAST(CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL AND l.credit > 0 THEN p.credited ELSE l.credit END AS INTEGER) AS credit, CAST(CASE WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN w.invoice WHEN COALESCE(e.doc_type, '') IN ('invoice', 'payment', 'credit_memo') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document, ''), NULLIF(r.document, '')) IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document, ''), r.document) WHEN e.reverses != '' THEN COALESCE((SELECT rl.id FROM books_journal_lines rl WHERE rl.entry = e.reverses AND rl.position = l.position), l.id) ELSE l.id END AS TEXT) AS item, CAST(CASE WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'invoice' WHEN COALESCE(e.doc_type, '') IN ('invoice', 'payment', 'credit_memo') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document, ''), NULLIF(r.document, '')) IS NOT NULL THEN e.doc_type ELSE 'entry' END AS TEXT) AS item_kind, CAST(CASE WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN wie.number ELSE COALESCE(r.number, e.number) END AS TEXT) AS item_number, CAST(CASE WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN wie.sequence ELSE COALESCE(r.sequence, e.sequence) END AS INTEGER) AS item_seq, CAST(CASE WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN wi.due_date WHEN COALESCE(e.doc_type, '') IN ('invoice', 'payment', 'credit_memo') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document, ''), NULLIF(r.document, '')) IS NOT NULL AND e.doc_type = 'invoice' THEN i.due_date ELSE COALESCE(r.date, e.date) END AS TEXT) AS due_date FROM books_journal_lines l JOIN books_accounts a ON a.id = l.account JOIN books_journal_entries e ON e.id = l.entry LEFT JOIN books_journal_entries r ON r.id = e.reverses LEFT JOIN books_payments p ON p.id = e.document AND e.doc_type = 'payment' AND p.entry = e.id AND p.status = 'posted' LEFT JOIN books_invoices i ON e.doc_type = 'invoice' AND i.id = COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document, ''), r.document) LEFT JOIN books_write_offs w ON e.doc_type = 'write_off' AND w.id = COALESCE(NULLIF(e.document, ''), r.document) LEFT JOIN books_invoices wi ON wi.id = w.invoice LEFT JOIN books_journal_entries wie ON wie.id = wi.entry WHERE l.posted = TRUE AND a.type = 'accounts_receivable'

SELECT pa.id AS id, 'application' AS source, p.customer AS customer, p.entry AS entry, p.date AS date, p.currency AS currency, CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS debit, pa.amount AS credit, CAST(pa.invoice AS TEXT) AS item, CAST('invoice' AS TEXT) AS item_kind, CAST(ie.number AS TEXT) AS item_number, CAST(ie.sequence AS INTEGER) AS item_seq, i.due_date AS due_date FROM books_payment_applications pa JOIN books_payments p ON p.id = pa.payment JOIN books_invoices i ON i.id = pa.invoice JOIN books_journal_entries ie ON ie.id = i.entry WHERE p.status = 'posted'

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ca.id AS id, 'application' AS source, m.customer AS customer, m.entry AS entry, ca.date AS date, m.currency AS currency, CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS debit, ca.amount AS credit, CAST(ca.invoice AS TEXT) AS item, CAST('invoice' AS TEXT) AS item_kind, CAST(ie.number AS TEXT) AS item_number, CAST(ie.sequence AS INTEGER) AS item_seq, CAST(i.due_date AS TEXT) AS due_date, ca.credit_memo AS credit_memo FROM books_credit_memo_applications ca JOIN books_credit_memos m ON m.id = ca.credit_memo JOIN books_invoices i ON i.id = ca.invoice JOIN books_journal_entries ie ON ie.id = i.entry WHERE m.status = 'posted' UNION ALL SELECT UPPER(ca.id) AS id, 'application' AS source, m.customer, m.entry, ca.date, m.currency, ca.amount AS debit, CAST(0 AS INTEGER) AS credit, CAST(ca.credit_memo AS TEXT), CAST('credit_memo' AS TEXT), CAST(me.number AS TEXT), CAST(me.sequence AS INTEGER), CAST(m.date AS TEXT), ca.credit_memo FROM books_credit_memo_applications ca JOIN books_credit_memos m ON m.id = ca.credit_memo JOIN books_journal_entries me ON me.id = m.entry WHERE m.status = 'posted') ca WHERE TRUE
settled:
WITH d AS (
		SELECT customer, item, date, SUM(debit - credit) AS net
		FROM books_receivable_items  GROUP BY customer, item, date
	), r AS (
		SELECT customer, item, date,
		       SUM(net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer, item ORDER BY date) AS bal
		FROM d
	), z AS (
		SELECT customer, item, date,
		       SUM(bal != 0) OVER (PARTITION BY customer, item ORDER BY date
		                           ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS later
		FROM r
	)
	SELECT z.customer AS customer, z.item AS item,
	       COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN z.later = 0 THEN z.date END), '9999-12-31') AS settled
	FROM z
	GROUP BY z.customer, z.item

UPDATE books_receivable_items SET settled = s.settled FROM (
	WITH d AS (
		SELECT customer, item, date, SUM(debit - credit) AS net
		FROM books_receivable_items  GROUP BY customer, item, date
	), r AS (
		SELECT customer, item, date,
		       SUM(net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer, item ORDER BY date) AS bal
		FROM d
	), z AS (
		SELECT customer, item, date,
		       SUM(bal != 0) OVER (PARTITION BY customer, item ORDER BY date
		                           ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS later
		FROM r
	)
	SELECT z.customer AS customer, z.item AS item,
	       COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN z.later = 0 THEN z.date END), '9999-12-31') AS settled
	FROM z
	GROUP BY z.customer, z.item) s WHERE s.customer = books_receivable_items.customer AND s.item = books_receivable_items.item AND s.settled != books_receivable_items.settled
